calls.statement:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) as year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) as month,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date)
ORDER BY year, month;

SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) as month,
  f.channel_code,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date), f.channel_code
ORDER BY month, channel_code;
